durable_state_loading.no_void_on_boot: V4 startup void loop completely removed; on boot or restart, active matches load directly from PostgreSQL without voiding; match remains PLAYING with identical revision, turn, deadline, and escrow
durable_state_loading.surviving_process_resume: Surviving or newly booted Core process loads committed match state via core.readMatch

kill_core_before_commit.scenario: Core aborted before PostgreSQL transaction commit
kill_core_before_commit.outcome: Transaction rolls back completely; zero move outcomes, zero outbox events, revision unchanged; surviving Core resumes game at previous revision

kill_core_after_commit.scenario: Core dies after commit before response/publish
kill_core_after_commit.outcome: Client retries with same operation_id on surviving Core; returns prior ack and snapshot idempotently; move outcome count is exactly 1

slow_client_backpressure.mechanism: sendFrame checks socket.bufferSize > maxBufferBytes (65536 B); stalled socket closed with close code 1008 (CLOSE_POLICY) instead of buffering unbounded frames
slow_client_backpressure.recovery: Stalled client reconnects and catches up cleanly via snapshot/delta recovery (V5-08-04)

multi_process_routing.mechanism: Transport subscribes to core-match pubsub channel; when Core A commits a move, Core B subscribers receive broadcast snapshot via Redis hint
multi_process_routing.fault_isolation: Termination or drain of Core A leaves Core B clients connected and unaffected

graceful_drain.mechanism: transport.beginDrain() refuses new ingress with HTTP 503, drains live sockets with close code 1000, and releases pubsub subscriptions

test_execution.command: env -u NODE_OPTIONS V5_PG_URL=postgres://postgres@127.0.0.1:50709/postgres V5_PG_DISPOSABLE=1 V5_PG_REQUIRED=1 REDIS_URL=redis://127.0.0.1:50710 node --test --test-reporter=tap --test-concurrency=1 tests/v5-p08-restart-recovery.test.js
test_execution.environment: owned loopback PostgreSQL 16.15 + real loopback Redis 127.0.0.1:50710

task_outcomes.V5-08-05: COMPLETE: memory-authoritative restart recovery removed. V4 startup void logic replaced with loading durable active state from PostgreSQL; kill Core before commit rolls back cleanly; kill Core after commit retries idempotently on surviving process; slow-client backpressure closes stalled sockets with 1008; multi-process routing synchronizes state across Cores over Redis hints; graceful drain implemented across 6 dedicated tests and 121 assertions on real PG16 + Redis.
